limitations: Synthetic incremental comparison against f9738174; no overall-stack, latest-main, competitor or global superiority claim.
All 22960 outputs were independently checked against fixed fixture references; this is not correctness for every PDF or continuous geometry.

Every structurally complete original pair is retained. The terminal incomplete attempt remains recorded and its pair is rerun in full.

The continuation guard and independent audit are required to pass; observation still cannot exclude brief jobs between scans or ordinary desktop interference.
WASI is a bounded portability/diagnostic comparison with no calibrated speed or RSS admission.

retention_decision.reason: All mandatory accuracy, resource, layout and portability gates passed. The independent audit verified all 22,960 scheduled outputs and retained all 3,310 completed original pairs plus 8,170 new pairs. Both designated sparse64/full latency gates pass: Exact median 7.668646 to 3.8338955 ms (50.01% less), Competitive 6.825750 to 3.0674165 ms (55.06% less). Retain the incremental output-conversion saving as a useful partial win under the explicit user-authorized continuation amendment.
retention_decision.restriction: Experimental branch only. No main/default/release or global superiority admission: only 17/54 protected latency and 30/56 sampled RSS gates pass. Exact target maximum RSS rises 6.60%; largest control maximum RSS rises 25.32%. Competitive opaque-tiny/cold median ratio 1.07483 with lower bound 1.05706 and opaque-clip/full p95 ratio 1.22510 with lower bound 1.04296 exceed the material-regression threshold. These misses remain unresolved; do not excuse them as noise or infer zero impact from the original presence-only guard. Cohort and checkpoint methods differ explicitly. Pause after publication and commit per the user; no further performance experiment.

wasi_review.reason: Both independent WASI audits passed exact analytic RGBA and same-mode equality for all336 SIMD and24 scalar outputs, with successful equal-feature builds, unchanged source and no detected contention. SIMD twelve-pair summaries are descriptive: sparse targets improved, while opaque Competitive and Exact pattern median point estimates rose. No calibrated latency, RSS or portable promotion is inferred. Native56-cell fixed pilot and confirmation remain required.
